metadata.target_conclusion: An ISIS (IS) flag is being displayed (by hostages) at the cafe in Sydney's Martin Place

attack_plan.narrative: Reports have emerged that one of the hostage takers in Sydney's Martin Place demanded an ISIS flag during the siege. According to Sky News, he also made a phone call to the Australian Prime Minister. Eyewitnesses describe hearing gunshots and explosions throughout the day, which culminated in a dramatic rescue operation involving local law enforcement. Security personnel recovered a flag resembling the ISIS emblem near the site of the siege. Meanwhile, footage shows individuals believed to be among the hostages emerging from the cafe, appearing shaken but otherwise unharmed.

posts.text: Emergency in Sydney's Martin Place! Hostage situation escalating. Gunshots heard, chaos on the streets.
Eyewitnesses report hearing explosions. Police forces mobilizing for a high-risk operation.
Australian PM reportedly received a threatening phone call from one of the hostage takers.
Security personnel recover a flag similar to ISIS emblem near the siege location. #SydneyHostageSituation
Hostages rescued, some appear shaken but unharmed. What was the message behind the flag?
